name: MikroTik RouterOS
description: Reads a MikroTik router, switch or access point (RouterOS 7.1+): the device as a network node, MikroTik neighbours (MNDP/LLDP) as child nodes, and the devices it knows as clients with their bridge port, DHCP lease, ARP entry or Wi-Fi registration (band, signal, link speed). Netlens uses this to place devices in the hierarchy and to show Wi-Fi signal history. Read-only: only GET requests to the REST API.
author: Netlens
supports: Wi-Fi registration tables and MNDP neighbours (not tested)

releases.changelog: The health of every device: processor, memory, temperature, uptime, firmware (and the newest version the router already knows of), the ports with link, speed and counters, and the interface of the default route as the internet connection. New setting Read the health of the devices. Needs Netlens 0.4.237.
Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
